surviving.title: DIRECT sun at a point: u_E_sun times the transmittance LUT (dome_3 sun-glare pass; same lookup in astronomical_4, ra10 sun disc)
surviving.stage: dome_3.spv (base; dome_6 identical but layer index). Lookup is the shared trans-LUT sampler used by every ray-marcher.
surviving.statement: The direct sun colour/irradiance at world position cam is E_dir = u_E_sun * T(r, mu_s) where r = |cam + (0, Rg, 0)| (y is up), mu_s = dot(P, u_sun_dir_wrl)/r, and T is u_tex_trans sampled with Bruneton's (x_mu, x_r) mapping with half-texel correction. dome_3 then multiplies by the glare lobe and u_exposure_scale[1].
surviving.pseudo_code:
// dome_3 body (cat -n of function) lines 3-14: view ray
ndc = v_ratio * u_proj_coefficients[v_eye].xy + u_proj_coefficients[v_eye].zw
V = normalize(vec3(ndc.x, ndc.y, -1))
// 15-28: glare
c = dot(V, u_sun_dir_eye)
glare = Exp(-u_sun_glare_falloff * FAbs(Acos(c)))
glare = (c > u_sun_glare_mask) ? 0 : glare          // disc core masked out (drawn by astronomical/ra10)
// 29-40: planet-relative camera
P = u_pos_cam_wrl; P.y += u_plan_rad_mtr             // Rg; y is up
r = Length(P); mu_s = dot(P, u_sun_dir_wrl) / r
// 41-80: transmittance LUT lookup (identical code in every module: 'T_LUT(r, mu)')
Ra = u_atmo_rad_mtr; Rg = u_plan_rad_mtr
H   = Sqrt(FMax(0, Ra*Ra - Rg*Rg))
rho = Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r - Rg*Rg))
d   = FMax(0, -r*mu + Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r*(mu*mu - 1) + Ra*Ra)))   // distance to top of atmosphere
d_min = Ra - r; d_max = rho + H
uv  = vec2((d - d_min)/(d_max - d_min), rho / H)
uv  = (1 - 1/size) * uv + 0.5/size                    // size = textureSize(u_tex_trans)
T   = texture(u_tex_trans, uv).rgb
// 81-93
out.rgb = u_E_sun * glare * T * u_exposure_scale[1]; out.a = 0; clamp to +-65504

inputs.name: u_E_sun
inputs.proposed_default: RGB sun irradiance at top of atmosphere; harness value 120000 lux (core/sky/plan.py) in the renderer's unit. The ra10 sun-disc constant 1.6e6 (true sun ~1.6e9 cd/m^2) suggests the unit is 1000 cd/m^2 -> u_E_sun ~ 120 (INFERENCE, flagged)

inputs.name: u_sun_dir_wrl / u_L_wrl
inputs.proposed_default: unit vector to the sun, y-up world frame (P = cam + (0,Rg,0)); from sun_elev/sun_azim; horizontal axis convention not decodable

inputs.name: u_plan_rad_mtr, u_atmo_rad_mtr
inputs.proposed_default: 6360000 m, 6420000 m (Bruneton 2017 model.cc Earth; UE SkyAtmosphere BottomRadius 6360 km + AtmosphereHeight 60 km)

inputs.name: u_sun_glare_falloff, u_sun_glare_mask
inputs.proposed_default: not decodable; mask = cos(sun radius) e.g. cos(0.27 deg)=0.99998889; falloff: CPU

inputs.name: u_exposure_scale[1]
inputs.proposed_default: 1.0 when the host does exposure itself (UE AutoExposureBias)

evidence.ids_or_lines: body lines 15-28 (%19466 dot, %15253 Exp(-falloff*|Acos|), %20143 select by u_sun_glare_mask); 29-40 (%9396 P with y+Rg, %18012 mu_s); 41-80 LUT mapping (%18676 x_mu, %21251 x_r, %12334 half-texel uv); 81-87 (%18794 u_E_sun*glare, %9197 *T, %9023 *u_exposure_scale[1])

port_to.python: core/xplane/atmosphere.py sun_transmittance(): replace the Bruneton single-medium integral by F2 (4 media, 40 midpoint samples) and return direct = E_sun * T(Rg+alt, sin(sun_elev)); this is the -xplane-direct colour (normalise, sRGB-encode as runs.py does).
port_to.ue: FlightSimVisualScene.cpp: ADirectionalLight sun intensity 120000 lux with SkyAtmosphere transmittance applied by the engine (bAtmosphereSunLight / TransmittanceMinLightElevationAngle already set); SetLightColor(Direct) only when the X-Plane colour path is on.

surviving.port_notes: The chain has no separate 'ground direct irradiance' pass: ground lighting elsewhere (terrain/ocean) uses u_E_sun * u_tex_trans exactly like this. Bruneton's sun-disc cosine factor (atmosphere_2) is NOT used at runtime.
surviving.correction: Exact version and precision fixes: (1) dome_6 is not 'identical but layer index': diff of the two bodies shows a single change at body line 91, `%25030 = OpCompositeConstruct %13283 %14867 %6565 c1` (output alpha 1) versus c0 in dome_3; headers and all other instructions are identical. (2) 'identical code in every module' is true for the LUT mapping but the ground-lighting modules wrap it in Bruneton's RayIntersectsGround guard that dome_3 and astronomical_4 lack: terrain/terrain_4.spv (dis lines 1490-1557) and ocean_shading/ocean_shading_1.spv (lines 475-541) compute %18867 = OpFOrdLessThan mu c0, and if true %19712 = OpFOrdGreaterThanEqual (r*r*(mu*mu-1) + Rg*Rg) c0; when both hold T = c(0,0,0) (OpPhi), else T = LUT; then E_dir = OpFMul u_E_sun T (terrain %22048 = OpFMul %22852 %19750; ocean %10069 = OpFMul %19748 %23743, with mu from the world-space sun direction %11559 / v_sun_dir). scatter_render_atmosphere_10 has the same guard (%18867/%19715/%10925). So the 'direct sun at a point' formula should be stated as E_dir = u_E_sun * (RayIntersectsGround(r, mu_s) ? 0 : T(r, mu_s)); the harness sun_transmittance() already implements this guard (hits_ground -> zeros). (3) In ra10 the sun disc is `%24380 = OpVectorTimesScalar T c1.6e+06; %9178 = OpVectorTimesScalar %24380 %19061` (disc factor) added to in-scatter*u_E_sun (%19130) before u_exposure_scale[1]; u_E_sun does NOT multiply the disc, so the inference 'unit = 1000 cd/m^2 -> u_E_sun ~ 120' rests on an assumption that the disc constant and u_E_sun share a unit, which the streams do not establish. (4) port_to python: core/xplane/atmosphere.py transmittance() already integrates three media (Rayleigh, Mie, ozone via _extinction) with RAY_SAMPLES = 48 midpoint samples, not a 'single-medium integral'; and the normalisation/sRGB encoding of the direct colour happens in atmosphere.sky_lighting() -> _srgb8(direct, white) (line 343-352), runs.py xplane_lighting_flags() only formats R:G:B. (5) port_to ue: TransmittanceMinLightElevationAngle is 'already set' but to 90 deg (FlightSimVisualScene.cpp line 643; FlightSimSky.cpp line 244 from plan.py line 411: 90.0 when sun elevation > 0, else -90.0), which makes the engine evaluate the sun's atmospheric transmittance as for a zenith sun by day, so the mu_s dependence of F1 is NOT reproduced by the engine path as configured; porting F1 through the engine requires lowering that floor (or applying the F1 colour via SetLightColor, which today only runs under Options.bXPlaneLighting, line 724). bPerPixelAtmosphereTransmittance = true (FlightSimSky.cpp line 241) does not bypass the floor.

surviving.title: Transmittance LUT u_trans_tex (scatter_compute_t_0): 4-medium optical depth, Bruneton (x_mu, x_r) parameterisation, 40 midpoint samples
surviving.stage: scatter_compute_t_0.spv (only module)
surviving.statement: Each texel (x = x_mu, y = x_r) stores exp(-(sigma_r*D_r + (u_scatter_m+u_absorb_m)*D_m + u_absorb_o*D_o)) along the ray from radius r, cosine mu to the top of the atmosphere; the fog medium's density is forced to 0 in this LUT. Density profiles: Rayleigh/Mie exponential exp(h*u_ele_*_mtr_inv) (member must be NEGATIVE = -1/H), ozone tent max(0, 1-|(h-u_ele_o_mtr)*u_rad_o_mtr_inv|).
surviving.pseudo_code:
// full-dis line numbers of scatter_compute_t_0.dis
uv = vec2(gid.xy) / vec2(size - 1)                     // 130-138
Ra = u_atmo_rad_mtr; Rg = u_plan_rad_mtr
H   = Sqrt(FMax(0, Ra*Ra - Rg*Rg))                     // 139-147
rho = H * uv.y                                         // 148-149
r   = Sqrt(rho*rho + Rg*Rg)                            // 150-152
d_min = Ra - r; d_max = rho + H                        // 153-154
d   = d_min + uv.x * (d_max - d_min)                   // 155-158
mu  = (d == 0) ? 1 : (H*H - rho*rho - d*d) / (2*r*d)   // 159-174
mu  = FClamp(mu, -1, 1)                                // 175
dist = FMax(0, -r*mu + Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r*(mu*mu-1) + Ra*Ra)))   // 176-186
step = dist * 0.025 (=1/40); t = dist * 0.0125 (= step/2)      // 187-188
acc = vec4(0)
for i in 0..40:                                         // 189-230
  h   = FMax(0, Sqrt(t*(t + 2*r*mu) + r*r) - Rg)        // 198-206
  d_r = Exp(h * u_ele_r_mtr_inv)                        // 207-210
  d_m = Exp(h * u_ele_m_mtr_inv)                        // 211-214
  d_o = FMax(0, 1 - FAbs((h - u_ele_o_mtr) * u_rad_o_mtr_inv))   // 215-223
  d_f = 0                                               // 224-225 (OpCompositeInsert c0 at .w)
  acc += vec4(d_r, d_m, d_o, d_f) * step                // 226-227
  t += step                                             // 228
tau = u_scatter_r*acc.x + (u_scatter_m + u_absorb_m)*acc.y + u_absorb_o*acc.z + (u_scatter_f + u_absorb_f)*acc.w   // 232-257
T = Exp(-tau)                                           // 258-259
store vec4(T, 1)                                        // 260-265

inputs.name: u_scatter_r
inputs.proposed_default: (5.802e-6, 13.558e-6, 33.1e-6) /m — Bruneton 2017 model.cc Earth at 680/550/440 nm (= UE SkyAtmosphere RayleighScattering 0.005802/0.013558/0.0331 per km)

inputs.name: u_ele_r_mtr_inv
inputs.proposed_default: -1/8000 m^-1 (negative sign required by Exp(h*k); Bruneton Rayleigh scale height 8 km; UE RayleighExponentialDistribution 8 km)

inputs.name: u_scatter_m, u_absorb_m

surviving.title: Sky radiance ray-march (the integrand shared by skydome 0-5, scatter_render_atmosphere 6-10 and scatter_compute_scattering): HORIZON colour = this at a horizontal view direction
surviving.stage: scatter_compute_skydome_0.spv (base, per-view dome). Same loop body in skydome_1/4 (different direction mapping), scs0 (froxels), ra6/ra10 (32 uniform steps instead of quadratic N).
surviving.statement: Sky radiance L(dir) = u_E_sun * sum over samples of T_acc * (S - S*exp(-ext*dt))/max(ext,1e-7), with S = T_sun*(sigma_r*phase_r + sigma_ms*phase_m + sigma_sf/(4pi))*u_debug[1] + Psi_ms*(sigma_ms + sigma_r + sigma_sf)*u_debug[2]; samples t_i = (i/N)^2*dist (i = 0.5,1.5,...), N = mix(u_dome_min_samples, u_dome_max_samples, clamp(dist*u_dome_max_samples_distance_inv)). dist = distance to the top of the atmosphere, or to a sphere of radius Rg-5000 m when the ray hits the ground. Output texel = (L, min(T.rgb)).
surviving.pseudo_code:
// skydome_0 body line numbers (sed -n '/^OpFunction/,$p' | cat -n)
uv  = (vec2(gid.xy) + 0.5) / vec2(size.x, size.y - 1)                 // 3-12
ndc = u_frustum_coefficients.xy * uv + u_frustum_coefficients.zw      // 13-18
dir = Normalize((u_modelview_matrix_inv * vec4(ndc, -1, 0)).xyz)      // 19-26
P = u_camera_wrl + vec3(0, Rg, 0); r = Length(P); mu = dot(P, dir)/r  // 27-38
Rgnd = Rg - 5000                                                      // 39
hits = (mu < 0) && (r*r*(mu*mu-1) + Rgnd*Rgnd >= 0)                   // 40-53
dist = hits ? FMax(0, -r*mu - Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r*(mu*mu-1) + Rgnd*Rgnd)))
            : FMax(0, -r*mu + Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r*(mu*mu-1) + Ra*Ra)))   // 54-87
N = int(FMix(u_dome_min_samples, u_dome_max_samples, FClamp(dist*u_dome_max_samples_distance_inv, 0, 1)))  // 88-97
cos_sv = dot(u_L_wrl, dir); mu_s = dot(u_L_wrl, P/r)                  // 98-103
phase_r = (1 + cos_sv*cos_sv) * 0.0596831          // 3/(16 pi)      // 104-106
x = (cos_sv > 0) ? cos_sv^4 : -cos_sv^2                                // 107-118
phase_m = Exp(texture(tex_mie_phase, vec2(FClamp(x*u_mie_decode[0] + u_mie_decode[1], 0, 1), 0.5)).r * u_mie_decode[2] + u_mie_decode[3])   // 119-136 (ra6/ra10: FMin(phase_m, u_mie_limit))
t_prev = 0; T = vec3(1); L = vec3(0); i = Fract(0.5) = 0.5           // 137-143
while i < N:                                                          // 144-147
  t = (i/N)^2 * dist; dt = t - t_prev                                 // 149-152
  r_t = Sqrt(t*(t + 2*r*mu) + r*r)                                    // 153-159
  mu_s_t = FClamp((r_t*mu_s + t*cos_sv)/r_t, -1, 1)                   // 160-164
  h = FMax(0, r_t - Rg)                                               // 165-166
  d_r = Exp(h*u_ele_r_mtr_inv); d_m = Exp(h*u_ele_m_mtr_inv)          // 167-174
  d_o = FMax(0, 1 - FAbs((h - u_ele_o_mtr)*u_rad_o_mtr_inv))          // 175-183
  f = FClamp(u_fog_ele.x*h + u_fog_ele.y, 0, 1); d_f = f*f*(3 - 2*f)  // 184-194 (smoothstep fog profile)
  sig_ms = u_scatter_m*d_m; sig_am = u_absorb_m*d_m; sig_r = u_scatter_r*d_r; sig_o = u_absorb_o*d_o   // 195-207
  sig_sf = u_scatter_f*d_f; sig_af = u_absorb_f*d_f                   // 208-214
  ext = sig_ms + sig_am + sig_r + sig_o + (sig_sf + sig_af)           // 215-218
  S_phase = sig_r*phase_r + sig_ms*phase_m + sig_sf*0.0795775 /*1/(4pi)*/   // 219-224
  S_iso   = sig_ms + sig_r + sig_sf                                   // 225-227
  shadow  = (mu_s_t < 0 && r_t*r_t*(mu_s_t*mu_s_t-1) + Rg*Rg >= 0) ? 0 : 1   // 228-242 (sun below local horizon)
  T_sun = T_LUT(r_t, mu_s_t) * shadow * 1 /*cloud-shadow slot*/       // 243-283 (F1 mapping)
  Psi   = texture(u_multi_tex, (1-1/size)*vec2(FClamp(0.5*mu_s_t+0.5,0,1), FClamp((r_t-Rg)/(Ra-Rg),0,1)) + 0.5/size).rgb   // 288-305
  S = T_sun*S_phase*u_debug[1] + Psi*S_iso*1 /*cloud slot*/ *u_debug[2]   // 284-311
  Sint = (S - S*Exp(-ext*dt)) / FMax(ext, 1e-7)                        // 312-318
  L += T * Sint; T *= Exp(-ext*dt)                                     // 319-321
  t_prev = t; i += 1
out = vec4(L * u_E_sun, FMin(T.r, FMin(T.g, T.b)))                    // 327-338
if u_dome_history_sample_alpha >= 0: out = isnan? prev : out*(1-a) + prev*a   // 339-365
out = any(isnan(out)) ? vec4(0,0,0,1) : out; store                     // 366-371

surviving.title: Multi-scattering LUT u_multi_tex (scatter_compute_multi_0): Hillaire 2020 Psi_ms = L2 / (1 - f_ms)
surviving.stage: scatter_compute_multi_0.spv (only module)
surviving.statement: Texel (x: mu_s = 2*uv.x - 1, y: r = Rg + uv.y*(Ra-Rg)) stores Psi_ms(r, mu_s) = mean_over_128_dirs(L2) / (1 - mean_over_128_dirs(f_ms)) with isotropic phase 1/(4pi), 20 uniform steps per direction, ground bounce with Lambert albedo u_debug[3]/pi, sun transmittance from u_trans_tex. Directions: cos(theta) = 1 - bitreverse32(i)*2^-31, phi = i*2pi/128, d.sun = cos(theta), d.up = sin(theta)*sin(phi).
surviving.pseudo_code:
// multi_0 body line numbers
uv = vec2(gid.xy)/vec2(size-1); r = Rg + uv.y*(Ra-Rg); mu_s = 2*uv.x - 1        // 3-22
acc_f = 0; acc_L = 0
for i in 0..128:                                                                   // 24-30
  rev = bitreverse32(uint(i))                                                      // 32-56
  phi = i * 0.0490874 (=2pi/128); cth = 1 - rev*4.65661e-10 (=2^-31)              // 57-60
  theta = Acos(cth); c_sun = Cos(theta) (= cth); mu = Sin(theta)*Sin(phi)          // 61-65
  albedo = vec3(u_debug[3])                                                        // 66-68
  hits = (mu < 0) && (r*r*(mu*mu-1) + Rg*Rg >= 0)                                  // 69-82
  dist = hits ? FMax(0, -r*mu - Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r*(mu*mu-1)+Rg*Rg))) : FMax(0, -r*mu + Sqrt(FMax(0, r*r*(mu*mu-1)+Ra*Ra)))   // 83-114
  dt = dist*0.05; t = dist*0.025; T = 1; L2 = 0; f = 0                              // 115-123
  for j in 0..20:                                                                  // 124-126
    r_t = Sqrt(t*(t+2*r*mu) + r*r); mu_s_t = FClamp((r_t*mu_s + t*c_sun)/r_t, -1, 1)   // 128-139
    h = FMax(0, r_t - Rg); dens = FMax(vec4(Exp(h*u_ele_r_mtr_inv), Exp(h*u_ele_m_mtr_inv), FMax(0,1-FAbs((h-u_ele_o_mtr)*u_rad_o_mtr_inv)), undef), 1e-11)   // 140-161
    ext  = u_scatter_r*dens.x + (u_scatter_m+u_absorb_m)*dens.y + u_absorb_o*dens.z   // 162-178
    sig  = u_scatter_r*dens.x + u_scatter_m*dens.y; scat = sig * 0.0795775 (1/(4pi))  // 179-181
    Tseg = Exp(-ext*dt)                                                             // 182-184
    T_sun = (mu_s_t < 0 && r_t*r_t*(mu_s_t*mu_s_t-1)+Rg*Rg >= 0) ? 0 : T_LUT(r_t, mu_s_t)   // 187-246
    L2 += T * (T_sun - T_sun*Tseg)/ext * scat                                       // 247-252
    f  += sig * T * (1 - Tseg)/ext                                                  // 253-258
    T *= Tseg; t += dt                                                              // 259-260
  if hits:                                                                          // 266-331
    r_g = Sqrt(dist*(dist+2*r*mu)+r*r); mu_s_g = FClamp((r_g*mu_s + dist*c_sun)/r_g, 0, 1)
    L2 += T * albedo * mu_s_g * T_LUT(r_g, mu_s_g) * 0.31831 (1/pi)
  acc_L += L2; acc_f += f
Psi = (acc_L * 0.0078125) / (1 - acc_f * 0.0078125)   // 1/128                     // 336-340
store vec4(Psi, 1)                                                                 // 341-346

surviving.correction: Formula is correct; precise version differs only in these details. (1) h is double-clamped: h = FMax(0, FMax(0, r_t - Rg)) (%10490, %23841), equivalent to the single FMax written. (2) There is no per-direction L2/f reset: the inner-loop accumulators are seeded from the outer accumulators (OpPhi %15153 <- %13052, %14344 <- %11175, lines 282-283) and the ground term is added to %15153 (%16186), so the stream accumulates directly into acc_L/acc_f; the sum is identical. (3) The f integrand multiplies Tseg by c1 first (%11700 = VectorTimesScalar %20933 c1) before 1 - Tseg; a no-op. (4) T_LUT(r, mu) is the Bruneton transmittance-UV mapping, transcribed at %369-405 (and duplicated at %446-482 for the ground sample): H = Sqrt(FMax(0, Ra^2 - Rg^2)); rho = Sqrt(FMax(0, r^2 - Rg^2)); d = FMax(0, -r*mu + Sqrt(FMax(0, r^2*(mu^2-1) + Ra^2))); d_min = Ra - r; d_max = rho + H; x_mu = (d - d_min)/(d_max - d_min); x_r = rho/H; uv = (0.5/size) + (1 - 1/size)*vec2(x_mu, x_r) where size = ImageQuerySizeLod(u_trans_tex, 0); sampled with OpImageSampleExplicitLod lod 0, .xyz taken. The ground-bounce lookup has no sun-below-horizon test (mu_s_g is already clamped to [0,1]). (5) Exact float constants: 2pi/128 = 0x3D490FDB (0.04908738657832146, i.e. the float32 of pi/64), 2^-31 = 0x30000000, 0.05 = 0x3D4CCCCD, 0.025 = 0x3CCCCCCD, 1/(4pi) = 0x3DA2F983, 1/pi = 0x3EA2F983, 1/128 = 0x3C000000, 1e-11 = 0x2D2FEBFF, -1 = 0xBF800000. (6) Input-role note: the exponents are Exp(+h*u_ele_r_mtr_inv) and Exp(+h*u_ele_m_mtr_inv) with no negation in the stream, so the CPU-set u_ele_*_mtr_inv members must carry the negative sign (-1/H) for the densities to decay with altitude; any proposed default must be entered as a negative reciprocal scale height. (7) The output is OpImageWrite to img_output_t at ivec2(gid.xy) with vec4(Psi.xyz, 1.0). (8) port_to UE: GroundAlbedo is not currently set anywhere in the host (only MultiScatteringFactor = 1.0f at FlightSimVisualScene.cpp:640), so the port is a new assignment Atmosphere->GroundAlbedo = FColor from u_debug[3] (linear albedo converted to the 8-bit sRGB FColor UE expects), not a change to an existing one.

surviving.title: SKY AMBIENT u_tex_sky_ambient (scatter_compute_skydome_4/5): sphere-mean of the sky ray-march per altitude row, times u_E_sun
surviving.stage: scatter_compute_skydome_4.spv (base; _5 adds cloud shadows)
surviving.statement: Texel (x, y) = (u_E_sun/256) * sum over 256 uniformly distributed sphere directions (including downward ones, which march to the Rg-5000 ground with no albedo term) of the F3 in-scatter radiance from the point at radius r = sqrt((H*y/(size.y-1))^2 + Rg^2) above u_camera_wrl.xz. Column x is not used by the computation (constant across x). Consumed by cloud_render_* and volumetric_fog as the ambient sky term.

// skydome_4 body line numbers; one 16x16 workgroup per output texel
idx = lid.y*16 + lid.x                                                    // 3-8
rev = bitreverse32(idx); phi = idx*0.0245437 (=2pi/256); cth = rev*4.65661e-10 - 1   // 12-39
sth = Sin(Acos(cth)); dir = Normalize(vec3(sth*Cos(phi), cth, sth*Sin(phi)))       // 40-48 (y up, full sphere)
v = float(wg.y)/(size.y - 1); H = Sqrt(FMax(0, Ra*Ra - Rg*Rg)); r = Sqrt((H*v)^2 + Rg*Rg)   // 56-74
P = vec3(u_camera_wrl.x, r, u_camera_wrl.z); r = Length(P); mu = dot(P, dir)/r        // 75-78, 136-139
// 79-123: dist with Rgnd = Rg-5000 as F3; 124-133: N as F3; 140-176: phases as F3; loop 178-357: identical to F3 (first sample i=0)
L_dir = L * u_E_sun                                                                // 359-361
sh_intermediate[idx] = L_dir; barrier; tree-reduce 256 -> 1 (adds at +128,+64,..,+1)  // 367-469
out = sum * 0.00390625 (=1/256); store vec4(out, 1) at (wg.x, wg.y)                  // 470-476

surviving.stage: scatter_render_atmosphere_10.spv (sky/space pass, no gbuffer)
surviving.statement: Where the view ray is within ~0.53-0.75 deg of the sun the pass adds 1.6e6 (constant radiance, NOT scaled by u_E_sun) times the transmittance from the camera toward the sun, then the whole sky output is scaled by u_exposure_scale[1]; alpha = 1 - mean(T).

if origin.y >= Ra-Rg: advance origin to the atmosphere entry (ray-sphere, radius Ra about (0,-Rg,0))   // 42-80
P = origin + (0,Rg,0); r = Length(P); mu = dot(P,dir)/r; dist = to top (Ra)          // 81-100
disc = SmoothStep(0.999914 (=cos 0.75deg), 0.999957 (=cos 0.53deg), dot(dir, u_L_wrl))  // 108-109

phi = 3.14159 + uv.x * 6.28319; polar = (0.5 - e) * 3.14159

surviving.title: Display tonemap chain: display_rgb = f(scene_rgb) (hdr_1 default mode)
surviving.stage: hdr_1.spv (base, 2D source, no guide). Identical back end in hdr_7 (MS: per-sample loop, average with u_sample_count_inv), hdr_11/12 (guide variant, see EXP-05), hdr_13/14 (false colour, EXP-09), resolve_3/7 (scalar luminance form, EXP-10), background_blur_3/5/7/8/9/10, exposure_fusion_0 (scalar form, EXP-02).
surviving.statement: The scene colour is clamped to the fp16 range, multiplied by u_exposure_scale.x and u_exposure_rat, graded by an ASC-CDL (slope normalised so that mid grey is preserved: k = pow(slope*mid_gray, 1/power)/mid_gray), transformed into the working colour space by u_wcs_matrix, compressed per channel by the rational curve w/(w + display_max*(1-mid_gray)), transformed back by u_wcs_matrix_inv, desaturated toward Rec.709 luma by u_asc_cdl_saturation, then gain/gamma'd, clamped to 0..1 and scaled by u_display_maximum. The source alpha passes through, the whole vec4 is multiplied by v_color (= u_imm_a_color from hdr_0), and NaNs become magenta. There is NO sRGB OETF in the shader: the target format or u_output_gamma supplies it.

k     = Pow(u_asc_cdl_slope * u_mid_gray, vec3(1)/u_asc_cdl_power) / vec3(u_mid_gray)   // %11412 %13653 %21973 %20920
cdl   = Pow(k * x + u_asc_cdl_offset, u_asc_cdl_power)                // %22786 %13506 %12272

surviving.title: Exposure fusion, pass 1: four synthetic exposures tonemapped to sRGB luminance

surviving.statement: For every pixel the pass takes scene rgb * u_exposure_rat, builds four exposures one 'u_shadow_gain' ratio apart (L/g, L, L*g, L*g^2), tonemaps each one's Rec.709 luminance with the EXP-01 curve in scalar form (CDL slope/offset/power collapsed to their luma-weighted scalars), sRGB-encodes the four results and stores them as one vec4 texel of img_luma. u_master_exposure and u_grayscale_coef are present in the block but never read.

if (gid.x < u_width && gid.y < u_height):                                  // %25076 %11454
  rgb = texelFetch(tex_original_image_2d, gid.xy, 0).rgb * u_exposure_rat   // %13396 %21829 %11411
  g   = u_shadow_gain                                                        // %19066
  E0 = rgb / vec3(g); E1 = rgb; E2 = rgb * g; E3 = E2 * g                   // %12501, %11411, %10120, %10121
  slope_l  = dot(u_asc_cdl_slope,  Lw)                                       // %19466
  offset_l = dot(u_asc_cdl_offset, Lw)                                       // %19467
  power_l  = dot(u_asc_cdl_power,  Lw)                                       // %19468
  k   = Pow(u_mid_gray * slope_l, 1/power_l) / u_mid_gray                    // %14747 %11134 %18640 %22342
  d   = u_display_maximum * (1 - u_mid_gray)                                 // %14778 %15203
  for i in 0..3:                                                             // E0: %14317 %25141 %17067 %21776 %7607 %14731 ; E1: %20694 %15494 %14732 %16054 ; E2: %15739 %15495 %16055 ; E3: %15740 %15496 %24222
    Yi = dot(Ei, Lw)
    ti = Pow(k * Yi + offset_l, power_l)
    vi = u_display_maximum * FClamp(ti / (ti + d), 0, 1)
  v  = vec4(v0, v1, v2, v3)                                                  // %15021
  lin  = 12.92 * v                                                           // %18612
  crv  = 1.055 * Pow(v, vec4(0.41666)) - 0.055                               // %20094 %24568 %14042   (0.41666 = 1/2.4)
  srgb = FMix(crv, lin, select(v <= 0.0031308, 1.0, 0.0))                    // %21279 %12740 %10248

surviving.statement: The weight per exposure channel is a Gaussian around display mid-value 0.5 of the sRGB-encoded luminance; u_sigma2 MULTIPLIES the squared distance, i.e. it is 1/sigma^2, not sigma^2. No contrast or saturation terms (only the well-exposedness term of Mertens et al.).

// exposure_fusion_1 main
if (gid.x < u_width && gid.y < u_height):

  L  = textureLod(tex_luma_2d, uv, 0)                             // %20809 (vec4 = 4 exposures)
  dL = L - vec4(0.5)                                              // %15617
  e  = ((dL * -0.5) * dL) * u_sigma2                              // %21342 %20453 %13308
  w  = Exp(e)                                                     // %23122   == exp(-0.5 * u_sigma2 * (L-0.5)^2)
  imageStore(img_weights_2d, gid.xy, w)                           // %9808 Op99

surviving.title: Laplacian-pyramid fusion accumulate (coarsest level, then per finer level)
surviving.stage: exposure_fusion_2.spv (first/coarsest level) and exposure_fusion_3.spv (every finer level), 2D. _6/_7 are the 2D-array twins with the +0.5 texel centre (%18603).
surviving.statement: At mip u_mip the normalised weights Wn = W/(sum(W)+1e-7) blend the four luminances; the coarsest level stores the Gaussian blend, each finer level adds the weighted Laplacian (L at mip minus L at mip+1) to the previous accumulation sampled bilinearly at lod 0 (hardware upsample). The red channel of the final accum image is the fused sRGB luminance used by hdr_11 as tex_lumi_guide.
surviving.pseudo_code:
// common
uv = vec2(gid.xy) * u_uv_scale; m = float(u_mip)                                  // %8864 %13492/%14765
// exposure_fusion_2 (coarsest level)
L  = textureLod(tex_luma_2d,    uv, m)                                              // %12443
W  = textureLod(tex_weights_2d, uv, m)                                              // %10997
Wn = W / vec4(dot(W, vec4(1)) + 1e-07)                                              // %23734 %12953 %13702
acc = dot(L * Wn, vec4(1))                                                          // %8427 %9925
imageStore(img_accum_2d, gid.xy, vec4(acc, 1, 1, 1))                                // %20662
// exposure_fusion_3 (finer level, u_mip = this level)
Lm  = textureLod(tex_luma_2d, uv, m)                                                // %20360
Lm1 = textureLod(tex_luma_2d, uv, m + 1)                                            // %8190 %23244 %24508
W   = textureLod(tex_weights_2d, uv, m); Wn = W / vec4(dot(W,vec4(1)) + 1e-07)      // %25270 %8886 %18576 %13702
prev = textureLod(tex_accum_2d, uv, 0).r                                            // %22626 %20552 (previous, coarser accum, bilinear upsample)
acc = prev + dot((Lm - Lm1) * Wn, vec4(1))                                          // %21924 %9719 %16871 %22412
imageStore(img_accum_2d, gid.xy, vec4(acc, 1, 1, 1))                                // %15024

surviving.correction: Formula is exact; only precision notes. (1) Both modules guard the whole body with if (int(gid.x) < u_width && int(gid.y) < u_height) (%15381 Bitcast uvec3->ivec3, %25076/%11454 OpSLessThan, %10924 OpPhi, OpBranchConditional); out-of-range threads write nothing. (2) 'bilinear'/'hardware upsample' is sampler state set by the host, not in the instruction stream: the SPIR-V only specifies ImageSampleExplicitLod with Lod = 0.0f (%2572) on tex_accum_2d and Lod = float(u_mip) / float(u_mip + 1) on tex_luma_2d at the same uv; Lm1 is the coarser mip of the luma pyramid sampled at the same normalised uv, not a separately upsampled image. (3) The finer-level LOD is float(u_mip + 1) with an integer add (%8190 OpIAdd %8761 c1, int 1) before the convert, not m + 1.0. (4) uv in _2/_3 is float(gid.xy) * u_uv_scale with no +0.5 (texel-corner addressing); the array twins _6/_7 use (float(gid) + vec3(0.5,0.5,0)) * vec3(u_uv_scale, 1) so the layer coordinate is float(gid.z). surviving.statement: The guide texel (fused sRGB luminance, EXP-04) is sRGB-decoded, clamped below display maximum, pushed back through the inverse of the EXP-01 luminance curve to the scene luminance that would produce it, and the pixel's rgb is scaled so its Rec.709 luminance equals that target; the EXP-01 back end then runs unchanged. u_exposure_rat is NOT applied in this variant (it was applied inside the fusion luma pass).

g     = texelFetch(tex_lumi_guide, ivec3(ivec2(uv * sz), int(layer)), 0).r           // %18171 %9213 %12832 %11920 %14042
g_lin = FMix(Pow(g * 0.947867 + 0.0521327, 2.4), g * 0.0773994, select(g <= 0.04045, 1, 0))   // %9045 %14431 %15790 %16678 %24545 %8786 %8834  (1/1.055, 0.055/1.055, 1/12.92: sRGB EOTF)

    counted = uint(weight)                                                                          // %10541

So u_bin_scales.zw is the inverse map (expected w = 1/y, z = -x) and the metered output is a temporally-adapted mean of the alpha channel stored in io_output texel (0,0,0).w. (2) Exact bin expression: bin = UClamp(ConvertFToU(Round(255.0f * ((a + u_bin_scales.x) * u_bin_scales.y))), 0u, 255u) — the float→uint conversion precedes the clamp, so a negative pre-clamp value is an out-of-range OpConvertFToU (undefined in SPIR-V), not a guaranteed 0; the clamp only bounds values above 255. (3) The 'MemoryBarrier' after the clear is OpMemoryBarrier(scope Workgroup=2, semantics 3400 = AcquireRelease|UniformMemory|WorkgroupMemory|AtomicCounterMemory|ImageMemory), i.e. groupMemoryBarrier(), not an execution barrier: nothing orders thread A's s_histogram_shared[A]=0 before thread B's atomicAdd into bin A. (4) All three OpAtomicIAdd use scope Device (1) and semantics Relaxed (0); OpControlBarrier is (Workgroup, Workgroup, 264 = AcquireRelease|WorkgroupMemory). (5) Any mode other than 0/1/2 counts nothing (inSpot false, %12025 false, %20786 false); weight defaults to 1 and is Bitcast int→uint (%14379). (6) Downstream caveat for the port (outside EXP-06 but affects what 'metered value' means): in lumi_histo_2 pixel_count is the same uninitialised Workgroup variable, read without any write except 'if (pixel_count==0) pixel_count=1', and used as the divisor of the mean, so the original app's average is hardware-/residue-dependent; a port should divide by the true summed weight (sum of bins) instead. (7) Proposed defaults are unverifiable from this module (u_bin_scales.xy are CPU-set and the alpha source is undecoded); keep them flagged as proposals.

surviving.title: Auto-exposure adaptation rule: mean of decoded bins, asymmetric temporal blend into io_output(0,0).w
surviving.stage: lumi_histo_2.spv (only variant); lumi_histo_3 = readback copy; histo_debug_0 = on-screen bars.
surviving.statement: Each of the 256 threads decodes its bin's value v_i = (i+0.5)/255*u_bin_scales.w + u_bin_scales.z and multiplies by the count; a tree reduction sums them; thread 0 divides by a Workgroup counter that no module ever writes (so it is 0 or garbage; 0 is guarded to 1), meaning the 1/N normalisation must be folded into u_bin_scales.z/.w by the CPU (u_pixel_count exists in the block but is never read). The CPU reads the bins (lumi_histo_3) and this texel to set the next frame's exposure.

surviving.correction: (1) The claim 'a Workgroup counter that no module ever writes' and the evidence quote '(no OpStore to it in this module)' are both false. lumi_histo_1 writes pixel_count: '%8710 = OpAtomicIAdd %pixel_count Scope=c1(Device) Semantics=c0 %11388' (last instruction before OpReturn), where %11388 = Phi(c0 if gl_GlobalInvocationID.xy outside u_image_width/height or the pixel is excluded, else %14379 = bitcast(%9750)), and %9750 = 1, or u_3d_window_count * ConvertFToS(Ceil(1/u_spot_radius)) (%6658) for pixels inside the spot when u_histo_mode==1. lumi_histo_2 itself also contains 'OpStore %pixel_count c1' (the 0->1 guard). So pixel_count is the intended weighted count of histogrammed pixels, but it is accumulated per 16x16 workgroup in lumi_histo_1's Workgroup memory and never copied to any buffer; lumi_histo_2 then reads a same-named Workgroup variable in a different dispatch, which the SPIR-V/Vulkan spec leaves undefined. 'It is 0 or garbage, guarded to 1' is therefore the right conclusion for a different reason: a cross-dispatch shared-memory read (a shader bug or driver-dependent behaviour), not an unwritten variable. (2) Consequently the inference 'the 1/N normalisation must be folded into u_bin_scales.z/.w by the CPU' is not decodable from the GPU side and should be dropped: the intended GPU formula is mean = sum_i bins[i]*v_i / sum(weights), with v_i the exact inverse of lumi_histo_1's bin map 'bin = UClamp(ConvertFToU(Round(c255 * ((hdr.w + u_bin_scales.x) * u_bin_scales.y))), c0, c255)' (%22565 %15241 %7323 %22285 %19513 %22701), i.e. w = 1/u_bin_scales.y, z = -u_bin_scales.x (the +0.5 is the bin-centre offset). Folding 1/N into z/w would also make histo_debug_0's test (%6896, the same decode) compare an N-scaled bin value against the unscaled adapted value in i_tone(0,0).w, unless the debug pass (u_histo_data at set 1 bind 1 vs set 0 bind 2 in compute) receives a differently scaled block. Revised proposal for u_bin_scales.zw under the [-8,16] EV proposal: w = 24, z = -8 (no /N), and a port computes adapted = mix(prev, (sum_i count_i*v_i)/N, prev > mean ? k_dark : k_bright) with an explicit weighted count N = sum of per-pixel weights (1, or u_3d_window_count*ceil(1/u_spot_radius) in spot mode). (3) Minor precision: in histo_debug_0 the bar height is added to a_vertex.y only for sub-vertices gl_VertexIndex%4 < 2 (%7503), bin index = gl_VertexIndex/4 (%24307); the yellow override keeps alpha = 1 from %19140. Everything else in the pseudo-code stands as written.

surviving.title: Bloom: soft threshold rip, 15-tap CPU blur per mip, mip-sum composite pow(sum*2^stops, exponent)
surviving.stage: bloom_0.spv (rip, non-MS), bloom_2.spv (rip, MS: samples averaged with u_sample_count_inv before the threshold), bloom_1.spv (blur), hdr_6.spv (composite). blur_1/blur_3 (archive blur) are the generic fragment equivalents of bloom_1 (u_taps[i].x gain, .y offset in u_pixel units, filter size SClamp 0..64).
surviving.statement: Rip: rgb * exp(-u_cut_lo_hi.x / max(luma, 1e-7)) (a smooth threshold that is ~0 far below cut and ~1 far above; u_cut_lo_hi.y is never read). Blur: sum over i < min(u_filter_size,15) of texel(gid.xy + u_offset_gain[i].xy) * u_offset_gain[i].z, both passes clamped to fp16 range with alpha 1. Composite: sum of textureLod over mips start..end, times u_bloom_coef.x (= 2^s_bloom1), raised to u_bloom_coef.y (= s_bloom_exponent), multiplied by v_color (u_imm_a_color) and drawn with alpha 1 (blend state outside the shader).
surviving.pseudo_code:
// bloom_0 main (compute), Lw = (0.2126,0.7152,0.0722)
if (gid.x < int(u_dst_width) && gid.y < int(u_dst_height)):                               // %6593 %25062 %20935 %8769
  rgb = texelFetch(s_rip_in, gid.xyz, 0).rgb                                               // %6913 %7546
  Y   = dot(Lw, rgb)                                                                       // %13051
  f   = Exp(-u_cut_lo_hi.x / FMax(Y, 1e-07))                                               // %7001 %14050 %15723 %9322 %14679
  out = FClamp(rgb * f, vec3(-65504), vec3(65504))                                         // %10935 %11076
  imageStore(i_rip_out, gid, vec4(out, 1))                                                 // %15931
// bloom_2: rgb = (sum_{s<u_sample_count} texelFetch(s_rip_in, gid, s)) * u_sample_count_inv, then as above   // %16954 %24414 %10642 %21900
// bloom_1 main (compute)
acc = 0; for i in 0 .. SMin(u_filter_size, 15)-1:                                          // %21432 %6526
  p   = gid.xy + ivec2(u_offset_gain[i].xy)                                                // %12598 %6757 %10649
  acc += imageLoad(i_blur_in, ivec3(p, gid.z)).rgb * u_offset_gain[i].z                    // %21238 %17866 %18439 %20683 %15571
imageStore(i_blur_out, gid, vec4(FClamp(acc,-65504,65504), 1))                             // %6467 %15931
// hdr_6 main (fragment, full-screen quad, v_color = u_imm_a_color)
sum = 0; for mip = u_bloom_start_mip .. u_bloom_end_mip:                                   // %6419 %23826
  uv = gl_FragCoord.xy*u_offset; layer = v_eye; if (uv.x>1) {uv.x-=1; layer+=1}            // %10506 %19913 %12017 %9058
  sum += textureLod(u_tex1, vec3(uv, layer), float(mip)).rgb                                // %16750 %9101 %23596
b   = Pow(sum * u_bloom_coef.x, vec3(u_bloom_coef.y))                                       // %21453 %11411 %20288
out = v_color * vec4(b, 1); out.a = 1; NaN -> (1,0,1,1)                                     // %6496 %17032 %10228 %16220
// blur_1 (fragment): n = SClamp(u_filter_size,0,64); acc = sum_i texture(u_tex, v_texcoord0 + u_pixel*u_taps[i].y).rgb * u_taps[i].x; out = (acc, v_alpha)   // %16529 %19904 %19434 %16288 %20683 %22409

surviving.title: Tonemapped MSAA resolve (resolve_3/7) and what it implies about u_exposure_scale
surviving.stage: resolve_3.spv (2D MS), resolve_7.spv (2D-array MS, adds v_eye layer). resolve_1/5/6/8 are plain copy / average variants (v_color * fetch, clamped). Not in the assigned archive list but it is the chain's MSAA step and the only module that uses BOTH components of u_exposure_scale.
surviving.statement: Each sample's luminance is pushed through the EXP-01 curve in scalar form (with x = rgb*u_exposure_scale.x*u_exposure_rat), the sample's rgb rescaled to that display luminance, the samples averaged with u_sample_weight, and the average pushed back through the inverse curve (same algebra as EXP-05) and rescaled by (1/u_exposure_rat)*u_exposure_scale.y. The round trip is brightness-neutral only if u_exposure_scale.x * u_exposure_scale.y == 1, so the two components are a reciprocal pre-/post-exposure pair: scene passes multiply radiance by .y when writing the HDR buffer, the display pass multiplies by .x.
surviving.pseudo_code:
// resolve_3 main (fragment); Lw = (0.2126,0.7152,0.0722)
for s in 0 .. SClamp(u_sample_count, 1, 32)-1:                                           // %16529 %6526
  p   = texelFetch(u_tex, ivec2(v_texcoord0), s)                                          // %9003
  x   = p.rgb * u_exposure_scale.x * u_exposure_rat                                       // %11411 %16199
  Y   = dot(x, Lw)                                                                        // %19799
  slope_l = dot(u_asc_cdl_slope,Lw); offset_l = dot(u_asc_cdl_offset,Lw); power_l = dot(u_asc_cdl_power,Lw)   // %19466 %19467 %19468
  k   = Pow(u_mid_gray*slope_l, 1/power_l) / u_mid_gray                                   // %14747 %11134 %18640 %22342
  t   = Pow(k*Y + offset_l, power_l)                                                      // %23609 %21983 %25141
  Ytm = u_display_maximum * FClamp(t / (t + u_display_maximum*(1-u_mid_gray)), 0, 1)      // %15203 %17067 %21776 %7607 %12472
  p.rgb = p.rgb * (Ytm / FMax(dot(p.rgb, Lw), 1e-06))                                     // %6265 %12592 %12810 %15667
  acc += p                                                                                // %22313
acc *= u_sample_weight                                                                    // %10642
Y   = dot(acc.rgb, Lw); n = FClamp(Y / u_display_maximum, 0, 0.999999)                    // %21900 %11494 %16712
t   = n*u_display_maximum*(1-u_mid_gray) / (1-n); Yinv = (Pow(t, 1/power_l) - offset_l) / k   // %17672 %8655 %19735 %24406 %24407 %22463 %12879
acc.rgb = acc.rgb * (Yinv / FMax(Y, 1e-06)) / u_exposure_rat * u_exposure_scale.y          // %14267 %16046 %15668 %7713 %10011 %9042
out = acc (alpha = averaged sample alpha)                                                 // %20564

surviving.title: JONSWAP x TMA energy spectrum per wave number (two summed components)
surviving.stage: ocean_spectrum_0.spv (only initial-spectrum module; _1/_2 are pack and time-evolution)

surviving.title: Dispersion relation, group-velocity factor, h0 amplitude and conjugate packing
surviving.stage: ocean_spectrum_0.spv (h0_temp, wave_table) and ocean_spectrum_1.spv (h0 pack)
surviving.statement: omega^2 = g k tanh(k d) (finite depth, clamped kd<=20); d omega/dk = g*(d k / cosh^2(kd) + tanh(kd))/(2 omega); h0(k) = xi * sqrt(2 * sum_c[S D fade] * |d omega/dk| / k * dk^2) with xi the Gaussian pair from u_noise (Tessendorf 2001 form, polar Jacobian included). ocean_spectrum_1 packs (h0(k), conj(h0(-k))) into vec4.

// ocean_spectrum_0, in-band branch, after omega (F1):
wave_table.d[i] = (k.x, 1/kLen, k.y, omega)                                          (%15611,%23648,%16340)
ch = Cosh(kd)                                                                        (%9174)

surviving.correction: Exact version and precision notes. (1) Statement wording: d omega/dk = 9.81 * (u_depth*kLen / cosh(kd) / cosh(kd) + tanh(min(kd, 20.0))) / omega * 0.5, where tanh reuses the CLAMPED %8685 from omega but cosh (%9174) takes the UNCLAMPED kd (%21233); for kd > ~89 cosh overflows to +inf in fp32 and the first term becomes 0 (finite, not NaN). The pseudo-code already says this; the statement should not write bare tanh(kd)/cosh^2(kd). (2) The u_noise note '1/sqrt2 folded into the 2*sum factor' is loose: the stream multiplies by 2.0 INSIDE the sqrt (i.e. a sqrt(2) factor outside), so relative to Tessendorf's (1/sqrt2)*xi*sqrt(P), P_eff = 4*sum*|dOmega/dk|/k*dk^2. The exact provenance of this form is the Horvath-2015 Cartesian discretisation h0 = xi * sqrt(2 S D fade |dOmega/dk| / k * dk^2) as used in the open-source 'FFT-Ocean' (gasgiant) InitialSpectrum kernel, whose Frequency/FrequencyDerivative (min(k*depth,20), ch = cosh(k*depth), g*(depth*k/ch/ch + th)/omega/2) and conjugate packing ((Size-x)%Size, (Size-y)%Size, float4(h.x,h.y,hm.x,-hm.y)) match this stream line for line; that implementation fills u_noise with Box-Muller N(0,1) pairs, so the N(0,1) proposal is well-founded but remains a proposal (texture content is CPU-set). (3) Inputs omitted from the list though used by the formula: u_size (member 10, offset 72, uint) = N for i and the conjugate index; u_length_scale (member 13, offset 88, float) via dk = 6.2831855 / u_length_scale (%11687); both CPU-set. (4) Out-of-band branch (%12148, kLen outside [u_cutoff[0], u_cutoff[1]]): h0_temp.h[i] = (0,0), wave_table.d[i] = (k.x, 1.0, k.y, 0.0) (%18260), so i_h0 = (0,0,0,1) there. (5) port_to.ue Gerstner amplitude 'a = sqrt(2 S D dk dtheta)' is not from the stream and drops the Jacobian; the variance-exact per-component amplitude on a (k, theta) grid is a = sqrt(2 S(omega) D(theta) fade (dOmega/dk) dk dtheta), and per Cartesian cell it is the stream's a = sqrt(2 S D fade |dOmega/dk| / k dk^2). Also state plainly that no receptor exists today: FlightSimVisualScene.cpp has only a WaterMask drape texel and RoughnessWater; core/scene/weather_visuals.py lists 'sea_state' under NOT_CLAIMED; core/environment/surface.py's 'ocean' class carries only a roughness length z0 and no wave input to core/fdm.

surviving.title: Time evolution h(k,t) and the 8 packed displacement/derivative spectra
surviving.stage: ocean_spectrum_2.spv
surviving.statement: h(k,t) = h0(k) e^{i omega t} + conj(h0(-k)) e^{-i omega t}; ih = i*h; horizontal displacement spectra Dx = ih kx/|k|, Dz = ih kz/|k|; slopes Dyx = ih kx, Dyz = ih kz; horizontal derivatives Dxx = -h kx^2/|k|, Dxz = -h kx kz/|k|, Dzz = -h kz^2/|k| (Tessendorf 2001 choppy-wave derivatives). Two real signals are packed per complex FFT channel as A + i B.

surviving.correction: (1) Inputs omit u_size: member 10 (uint, off 72) of the same Uniform block, CPU-set, used in i = y*u_size + x (%10687/%20036/%15486). Proposed default N = 256 (proposal, consistent with the u_stride = N*N proposal). (2) port_to: the harness has no Gerstner fallback, no CPU height probe and no ifft anywhere (grep gerstner|height.?probe|ifft|tessendorf over core/, webapp/, ue/ returns nothing; the only water receptor is core/xplane/drape.py's flat per-tile colour, which takes no height field, and the UE host has no water surface). Both port targets are new code, so write 'a Gerstner fallback (to be added)', not 'the Gerstner fallback'. (3) Sign convention: the stream's displacement channel is +i*k_hat*h (ih*w.x*w.y, ih*w.z*w.y), the negative of Tessendorf's D = sum(-i k_hat h). The actual sign and magnitude of the horizontal displacement are applied downstream in ocean_bake_textures_0 by the CPU-set u_lambda (member 1 of u_ocean_bake_textures_data) on the post-IFFT real fields: output layer 2z = (u_lambda*Dx, h, u_lambda*Dz, 5.0) (%10584 %13571 %14315 c5 -> %17282) and layer 2z+1 = (Dyx, Dyz, u_lambda*Dxx, u_lambda*Dzz) (%22219 -> %16007). A Gerstner port must therefore use +lambda * k_hat * A * sin(.) with lambda taken from the host value (sign included), not an assumed -lambda. (4) Out-of-cutoff bins (|k| outside u_cutoff) have wave_table = (k.x, 1, k.y, 0) and h0_temp = 0 (ocean_spectrum_0 %18260, c(0,0) store), so h = 0 and all eight channels are zero there; the formula holds trivially but a CPU port must apply the same cutoff.

surviving.title: light_transform: how named lights become tile lights (night-level hash gate, flash patterns, colour/intensity scaling, culling)
surviving.stage: light_transform_0.spv (dec/light_transform_0.dis, main function; _1 adds a debug SSBO only)
surviving.statement: Each input light is moved to eye space, scaled and gated: out.color = in.color * on * u_light_transform_colour_attenuation; out.attenuation = |in.attenuation| * sat(z_eye*dist.x + dist.y) * u_light_transform_night_level; the on/off state is a per-light hash gate (fract(|x+y+z|) <= u_light_time.x) for lights flagged by a negative attenuation (point) or negative pattern (spot), plus triangle / duty-cycle flash patterns driven by u_light_time.y; lights are culled by distance fade, frustum sphere, projected size and a hierarchical z test.
surviving.pseudo_code:
for each light k in [u_light_transform_start, +u_light_transform_count):  // %24645
  in = g_in_light_list.lights[k]
  pe = u_light_transform_modelview * vec4(in.position, 1); pos_eye = pe.xyz / pe.w   // %11434 %8560 -> %19588
  dist_fade = sat(pos_eye.z * u_light_transform_distance_attenuation.x + u_light_transform_distance_attenuation.y)   // %8864 %11632 %11044
  att = abs(in.attenuation) * dist_fade                                      // %9661 %6234
  r_cull = sqrt(max(in.color.r, max(in.color.g, in.color.b)) * att * u_light_transform_attenuation_factor)   // %8865 %9594 %12001 %23270
  visible = dist_fade > 0                                                    // %12811 %24073
  if (u_light_transform_cull_frustum) for 6 planes: if (dot(in.position, plane.xyz) + plane.w < -r_cull) visible = false   // %14176 %15770
  if (!visible) continue                                                     // %22068
  if (abs(in.cos_theta) != 1) {  // spot                                      // %24466 %15301
    dir_eye = mat3(u_light_transform_modelview) * normalize(in.direction)    // %10859 %12713
    c = abs(in.cos_theta); r_cull = mix(r_cull/2, r_cull/2 * sqrt(1 - c*c)/c, sat(abs(dot(normalize(-pos_eye), dir_eye))))   // %22850 %11386 %16212 %14690
  }
  // projected size test
  lo = project(pos_eye - vec3(r_cull, r_cull, 0)); hi = project(pos_eye + vec3(r_cull, r_cull, 0))   // %8541 %8849
  if (max(abs(hi.x - lo.x), abs(hi.y - lo.y)) < u_light_transform_min_size) continue   // %12795 %20830
  if (u_light_transform_z_test) { mip = int(max(0, log2(max(0.25*size_ndc * viewport)))); zmin = min of 4 texelFetch(u_tex_z_minmax, corner >> mip, mip).x converted with u_clip_info[0]; if (zmin > pos_eye.z + r_cull) continue }   // %15425 %10354 %13104 %14557
  hash = fract(abs(pos.x + pos.y + pos.z)); gate = step(hash, u_light_time.x)   // %13293 %24843  (1 iff hash <= u_light_time.x)
  if (spot) {
    rate = in.direction.x; pat = in.direction.y; t = u_light_time.y          // %7160 %23813 %15196
    pos = (pat > 0) ? 1 : 0                                                  // %19736
    if (abs(pat) < 1000) on = clamp((abs(2*fract(t*rate + fract(abs(pat))) - 1) * floor(abs(pat)) + (1 - floor(abs(pat)))) * (gate*(1 - pos) + pos), 0, 1)   // %10468 %16426 %13468 %17586 %15714
    else on = step(0, (floor(abs(pat)) - 1000)*0.001 - fract(t*rate - fract(abs(pat)))) * mix(1, pos, gate)   // %9763 %8103 %23279 %18100 %22213
  } else on = (in.attenuation < 0) ? gate : 1                                // %24298 %11433
  o = g_out_light_list.lights[atomicAdd(light_count, 1)]                     // %6327
  o.position = pos_eye; o.cos_theta = in.cos_theta                           // %13405 %20714
  o.color = in.color * on * u_light_transform_colour_attenuation             // %12220 %11430
  o.attenuation = abs(att) * u_light_transform_night_level                   // %22026 %8883
  o.direction = spot ? dir_eye : in.direction                                // %7755
  o.light_bits = in.light_bits & u_light_transform_light_mask                // %7248

surviving.statement: Each light is 3 screen-aligned quads (one per u_photo_cell entry). Photometric lights (texcoord1.x < 0, I_cd = -texcoord1.x): v_color = u_rgba_tinting * colour * min(u_photo_k * I_cd * flash * dist^cell.distance_exp * spot * cell.attenuation, u_exposure_ref * 2^cell.exp_lim); quad size in metres = 4 pixels at that depth x cell.size, shrunk by sat(lum/u_exposure_ref * u_cutoff.x + u_cutoff.y); legacy lights use the u_light_exp/u_light_scale/u_light_range size model and u_legacy_nts x elevation attenuation. surviving.title: resolve: MSAA resolve of the HDR buffer in a tonemapped-luminance space (ASC-CDL luminance curve), inverted back; plain resolve variants
surviving.stage: resolve_3.spv (fragment with u_tonemap_data, dec/resolve_3.dis main; resolve_7 identical on a 2D-array MS source), resolve_5.spv (plain MS average), resolve_1/4/6/8 (non-MS or array copies)
surviving.statement: Samples are averaged after mapping their Rec.709 luminance through Yc = pow(k*Y + offset_l, power_l) with k = pow(mg*slope_l, 1/power_l)/mg and tm = Dmax*sat(Yc/(Yc + Dmax*(1-mg))), then the average is inverted through the same curve; net single-sample transfer is c * u_exposure_scale.x * u_exposure_scale.y. The display tonemapper members (u_tonemap_mode, u_wcs_*, u_output_gain/gamma, u_asc_cdl_saturation) are not referenced.
surviving.pseudo_code:
n = clamp(u_sample_count, 1, 32); Y709 = vec3(0.2126, 0.7152, 0.0722)         // %16529
sl = dot(u_asc_cdl_slope, Y709); so = dot(u_asc_cdl_offset, Y709); sp = dot(u_asc_cdl_power, Y709)   // %19466 %19467 %19468
mg = u_mid_gray; Dmax = u_display_maximum
k = pow(mg*sl, 1/sp) / mg                                                    // %14747 %11134 %18640 %22342
acc = vec4(0)
for (s = 0; s < n; s++) {
  c = texelFetch(u_tex, ivec2(v_texcoord0), s)                               // %9003
  Y = dot(c.rgb * u_exposure_scale.x * u_exposure_rat, Y709)                 // %11411 %16199 %19799
  Yc = pow(k*Y + so, sp)                                                     // %23609 %21983 %25141
  tm = Dmax * sat(Yc / (Yc + Dmax*(1 - mg)))                                 // %15203 %17067 %21776 %7607 %12472
  c.rgb *= tm / max(dot(c.rgb, Y709), 1e-6)                                  // %6265 %12592 %12810 %15667
  acc += c                                                                   // %22313
}
acc *= u_sample_weight                                                       // %10642
Ya = dot(acc.rgb, Y709); u = clamp(Ya / Dmax, 0, 0.999999)                    // %21900 %11494 %16712
Yi = (pow((u*Dmax*(1 - mg)) / (1 - u), 1/sp) - so) / k                       // %17672 %8655 %19735 %24406 %24407 %22463 %12879
acc.rgb *= Yi / max(Ya, 1e-6)                                                // %14267 %16046 %15668
acc.rgb = acc.rgb / u_exposure_rat * u_exposure_scale.y                      // %7713 %9042
data_out0 = clamp(acc * v_color, -65504, 65504)                              // %19678 %19446

surviving.title: Froxel fog integration: quadratic depth slices, per-slice Beer-Lambert in-scatter, aerial-perspective coupling (the fog colour as a function of distance)
surviving.stage: volumetric_fog_3.spv (integration pass; main body lines counted from 'OpFunction %main' in dec/vf_3.dis)
surviving.statement: The fog volume is integrated front-to-back over N quadratic depth slices; each slice adds T*F.rgb*(1-exp(-F.a*dt)) with F = froxel density texel (rgb = lit radiance per unit extinction, a = extinction 1/m), and the stored fog texel is img[k].rgb = T_ap*L + S_ap*(1-T), img[k].a = 1-T where (S_ap, T_ap) are the sky chain's aerial-perspective in-scatter / transmittance at the slice-mid distance. This is Koschmieder-free: all distance haze enters through S_ap/T_ap.
surviving.pseudo_code:
// per pixel (x,y); N = u_volumetric_fog_depth_slices; D_km = u_volumetric_fog_max_distance (km)
uv      = (pix + (0.5,0.5)) * u_volumetric_fog_screen_size.zw                       // L19-23
dir     = Normalize(vec3(uv*u_volumetric_fog_frustum_proj_coeff.xy + .zw, -1))         // L107-116
inv_z   = -1 / dir.z                                                                   // L117-118
scene_t = (u_volumetric_scene_z_mip >= 0) ? -linearize_z(min over layers gbuffer_pos.x) : D_km   // L28-75 (linearize = (z*c0+c1)/(z*c2+c3), u_clip_info[0])
img[0]  = (0,0,0,0)                                                                    // L76-81
L = (0,0,0); T = 1
for k = 1 .. N-1:                                                                      // L84-92
  t_prev = D_km*1000*inv_z*(max(0,k-1)/N)^2 ; t_k = D_km*1000*inv_z*(k/N)^2            // L100-122
  if T > u_volumetric_march_opacity_floor:                                             // L94-98
    if t_prev < scene_t:                                                               // L125-127
      dt = (t_k - t_prev) / u_volumetric_fog_samples_per_slice                         // L129-132
      for s = 0 .. samples_per_slice-1:                                                // L134-140
        t  = t_prev + dt*s ; p = dir*t                                                 // L142-144
        w  = Sqrt( (p.z * -0.001) / D_km )            // == k/N : slice coordinate     // L145-148
        F  = tex3D(u_tex_volumetric_density, (pix+0.5)*u_viewport_size.zw, w)         // L123-124,149-153
        Tst = Exp(-F.a * dt)                                                           // L155-158
        sig = FMax(1e-05, F.a)                                                         // L159
        L  += T * ((F.rgb*sig) - (F.rgb*sig)*Tst) / sig      // == T*F.rgb*(1-Tst)      // L160-166
        T  *= Tst                                                                      // L167
    if T <= opacity_floor: T = 0                                                       // L175-176
  // aerial perspective at the slice-mid distance
  t_mid = D_km*1000 * FMix(((k-1)/N)^2, (k/N)^2, 0.5) ; p = dir*t_mid   (dir re-normalised, no inv_z)   // L181-201
  uv_ap = p.xy*u_frustum_coefficients_inv[0].xy/(-p.z) + u_frustum_coefficients_inv[0].zw           // L202-212
  z_ap  = FClamp(p.z*(-u_ap_near_far_z.z) + u_ap_near_far_z.w, 0, 1)                                 // L213-220
  c     = (uv_ap, Sqrt(z_ap)) * u_scatter_resolution_inv                                             // L221-225,240-242
  fade  = (Sqrt(z_ap)*size_z(u_tex_out_scatter) < 0.5) ? FClamp(2*Sqrt(z_ap)*size_z, 0, 1) : 1        // L226-239
  S_ap  = tex3D(u_tex_in_scatter, c).rgb * fade                                                      // L243-247,251
  T_ap  = (1,1,1) - ((1,1,1) - tex3D(u_tex_out_scatter, c).rgb) * fade                               // L248-254
  img[k].rgb = T_ap * L + S_ap * (1 - T)                                                             // L255-258
  img[k].a   = 1 - T                                                                                 // L256,264-265

surviving.title: Cloud/fog phase function: Cornette-Shanks (8*pi normalisation), g = u_phase_g
surviving.stage: cloud_render_raster_28.spv (base) phase_mie_hi, dec/crr_28.dis L795-827; identical inline in volumetric_fog_1.spv (dec/vf_1_body.txt L669-688) with g = u_cloud_phase_g; all 48+24 cloud_render variants contain c25.1327
surviving.statement: phase(mu) = 3(1-g^2)(1+mu^2) / (8*pi*(2+g^2)*(1+g^2-2*g*mu)^1.5) with mu = dot(L, V). Exactly the Cornette-Shanks (1992) phase used by Bruneton for Mie; not Henyey-Greenstein.

mu    = Dot(u_cloud_light.xyz, dir_wrl)        // crr_28 L1898 (%23446); vf_1: Dot(Normalize(light_dir), Normalize(dir_wrl)) L669-671
g     = u_phase_g                               // crr_28 L1900-1901; vf_1 u_cloud_phase_g L672-673
g2    = g*g                                     // L801-802
num   = 3*(1 - g2) * (1 + mu*mu)                // L803-809
den   = 25.1327 * (2 + g2) * Pow(1 + g2 - 2*g*mu, 1.5)   // L811-825 ; 25.1327 = 8*pi
phase = num / den                               // L826

L   = u_cloud_light.xyz ; lum = FAbs(u_cloud_light.w)              // crr_34 L1816-1818 (%22602), L1893-1895
Ls3 = u_shadow_length * 3                                          // L1813-1815 (%11771)
str0 = wrl_to_str(P) ; dstr = wrl_to_str(P + L*Ls3) - str0         // L1819-1822
od = 0 ; x = u_shadow_inv_step ; x2_prev = 0                       // L1823-1825
while x <= 1.01:                                                   // L1830-1833
  x2 = x*x ; dx2 = x2 - x2_prev                                    // L1835-1837
  ds = density(str0 + dstr*x2, add_noise_hi=false, want_sdf=false) // L1838-1840 (F8 with nhi=0.5, d2=0, dc=1)

if u_cloud_light.w > 0: light_col = u_cloud_light_color * outscatter_to_sun_with_shadow(P, L)   // crr_34 L1909-1913 (F6)
else:                   light_col = u_cloud_light_color * (ns_outscatter_to_moon_with_shadow(P, L) ? 0 : 1)   // L1902-1908 (returns 0 if ray hits ground else 1)
phase   = phase_mie_hi(Dot(L, dir_wrl), u_phase_g)                 // L1916-1922 (F2)

S_sun   = light_col * ( lum * (phase*T_sun + ms*T_sunms) )         // L1950-1954 (%21586,%23967,%18076,%8808,%13921)
// volumetric_fog_1 (vf_1 L791-803): S_sun = (u_cloud_light_color * T_atmo) * u_volumetric_fog_light_lum * (phase*T_sun + ms*T_sunms) with T_sun = Exp(-(od + cascade)) (L689-690) and T_sunms = FMix(Exp(-od), Exp(-ms_att*od), ms_mix) (L693-700)

surviving.title: Fog/cloud application to the lit image (volumetric_apply) and the categorize test
surviving.stage: volumetric_apply_1.spv (dec/va_1.dis body L1-85; va_2 = MSAA sample variant), volumetric_apply_3.spv (dec/va_3.dis body; va_4..6 variants), cloud_categorize_1.spv (dec/cc_1.dis body)
surviving.statement: Fog apply: fog = tex3D(u_tex_volumetric_fog, (uv_f, sqrt(clamp(z_f*(-near_far.z)+near_far.w,0,1)))) with (uv_f, z_f) from the scene-depth point transformed by u_apply_volumetric_fog_slice_to_fog_eye; output (fog.rgb, fog.a) and discard if a == 0 (blend = pipeline state, premultiplied). Cloud apply: 2x2 gather of the cloud colour taps whose depth*1000/u_volumetric_apply_cloud_far_depth_margin < scene distance; bilinear if all 4 valid, average of valid taps otherwise (edge-aware upsample).
surviving.pseudo_code:
// va_1
z   = gbuffer_pos[pix, eye].x ; z_lin = (z*u_clip_info[eye].x + .y)/(z*u_clip_info[eye].z + .w)                 // L6-33
p   = ( (pix + u_sample_offset)*u_viewport_size.zw * u_proj_coefficients[eye].xy + .zw ) * (-z_lin), z_lin      // L14-47
pf  = u_apply_volumetric_fog_slice_to_fog_eye[eye] * (p, 1)                                                      // L44-47
uvf = pf.xy*u_apply_volumetric_fog_proj_coeff_inv.xy/(-pf.z) + .zw                                              // L48-60
zf  = FClamp(pf.z*(-u_apply_volumetric_fog_near_far.z) + u_apply_volumetric_fog_near_far.w, 0, 1)                // L61-66
fog = tex3D(u_tex_volumetric_fog, (uvf, Sqrt(zf)))                                                              // L67-75
if fog.a == 0: discard ; data_out0 = fog                                                                        // L76-83
// va_3 (per cloud buffer 1 then 0)
dist = Length(p) ; depths = Gather(u_tex_cloud_depths, uv, eye).x*1000 / u_volumetric_apply_cloud_far_depth_margin   // L48, L55-69
valid = depths < dist (4 taps)                                                                                   // L70-72
all valid  -> colour = tex2DArray(u_tex_cloud_colour, (uv,eye)) (bilinear)                                       // L218-222
some valid -> colour = sum(valid*tap)/count, or edge-snapped bilinear when exactly one row/column is valid        // L79-213
none valid -> (0,0,0,0) ; discard if colour.a == 0                                                               // L216, L397-403

Component roles are corroborated upstream by ocean_spectrum_2.spv: fft.d[idx+u_stride*u_offset] = (%11115,%9380,%18454,%16339) = (Dx.re-Dz.im, Dx.im+Dz.re, Dy.re-Dxz.im, Dy.im+Dxz.re) i.e. complex pairs (Dx+i*Dz, Dy+i*Dxz), and fft.d[idx+u_stride*(u_offset+1)] = (%11116,%8430,%11117,%8299) = (Dyx+i*Dyz, Dxx+i*Dzz), where wave_table.d = (kx, 1/|k|, kz, omega) (%12710), h = h0.xy*e^{i w t} + h0.zw*e^{-i w t} (%22437), ih=(-h.y,h.x) (%21826), Dx=ih*kx/|k| (%24732), Dz=ih*kz/|k| (%24844), Dxz=-h*kx*kz/|k| (%10406), Dyx=ih*kx (%19928), Dyz=ih*kz (%13894), Dxx=-h*kx*kx/|k| (%10404), Dzz=-h*kz*kz/|k| (%22186); so after the packed real IFFT A=(Dx,Dz,Dy,Dxz), B=(Dyx,Dyz,Dxx,Dzz) as the decoder labelled. Refuting grounds (rule: port_to names a receptor that does not exist): (1) python port_to targets 'a whitecap amount in sea.json' -- no sea.json exists anywhere in the repo (only sky.json), and 'sea_state' is explicitly listed in NOT_CLAIMED at core/scene/weather_visuals.py:114; (2) UE port_to targets 'Water material: foam mask ... render-target ping-pong, or UE Water's built-in foam' -- the harness states there is NO water surface or water material in the host, the UE plugin lists sea_state under not_claimed (FlightSimVisualScene.cpp:772 and :2271), and the only water-related receptors are the terrain composite material's WaterMask drape texel (line 274) and RoughnessWater scalar (line 302; drape.py:168 default 0.08) plus core/xplane/drape.py:water_colour() (line 323). Minor imprecision also in port_to: 'saturate(1 - J)' is not in the shader; the stored .w is the min-tracked Jacobian itself (no saturate, no branch; it can go negative when J<0), and how ocean_shading maps .w to a foam amount was not verified here.
